           MITCHELLA REPENS

         Partridge-berry

        (MITCHELLA)


Bladder symptoms accompany complaints, especially uterine congestion.



Urinary.--  Irritation at neck of bladder, with urging to
        urinate (  Eup purp; Apis  ). Dysuria. Catarrh of bladder.



Female.--  Cervix dark red, swollen. Dysmenorrhœa and uterine hæmorrhage;
        blood bright red.



Relationship.--  Compare:   Chimaph;
        Senecio; Uva; Geran; Gossyp  .



Dose.--  Tincture.
